faqs.q: Do gutter guards eliminate gutter cleaning on Orange homes?

runs.v: No. No gutter guard is fully maintenance-free, per This Old House and Consumer Reports; in a 2025 This Old House survey, 63% of homeowners still cleaned at least once a year.

faqs.q: Which gutter guard is best for Orange's street-tree debris?

runs.v: Micro-mesh for fine seeds and grit; screen or reverse-curve for heavy leaf fall, per This Old House.

faqs.q: How do gutter guards work on Orange rental and multi-family buildings?

runs.v: The gutter is corrected first, and access is scheduled through the landlord or property manager.

faqs.q: Do gutter guards prevent ice dams?

runs.v: No. Ice dams start with attic heat loss, per University of Minnesota Extension; a guard keeps leaves out but cannot stop water refreezing at a cold eave.

faqs.q: How long do gutter guards last in Orange's climate?

runs.v: Micro-mesh lasts longest, often with a 20- to 25-year or lifetime warranty; foam and brush guards last a few years, per EcoWatch.

faqs.q: How much does gutter guard installation cost in Orange, NJ?

runs.v: Roughly $22 to $26 per linear foot installed, per This Old House.
